task: Exploratory sequential one-hour delivered-power forecasting at existing sites
split: Use unchanged prepared per-site chronological 70/15/15 calendar boundaries and quality filters
preprocessing: Use unchanged training-only medians, scaling, dropped features and missing indicators
fit_scope: Separate model per site, training partition only; no refit with validation or test
selection: Lowest validation MAE within each family, then across families including baselines. Ties use listed order. Freeze all selections before test scoring.
predictions: Clip model outputs below zero to zero, consistently in validation and test; retain raw outputs and clipping counts
seasonal_fallback: Use lag 24 clock hours; if missing, use lag 1 hour. Report fallback counts.
uncertainty: Point predictions only. No calibrated interval or growth model claimed.
test_status: Later hours of already-seen sites; previously inspected campaigns, not a fresh blind external or held-out-site test
